zh-CN.name: 山海周刊
zh-CN.subject: 山海周刊 #42：把时间留给好奇心
zh-CN.text: 本周精选：城市漫步、独立书店与慢生活。找一个晴朗的下午，去探索熟悉街区里未曾走过的小路。
zh-CN.html:
山海 JOURNAL / ISSUE 42

把时间留给好奇心

关于城市、自然，以及日常的小小发现。

一座城市的另一种打开方式

不用走得很远。沿着河岸散步，走进街角的小书店，和咖啡师聊聊今天的新豆子——灵感就藏在这些细节里。

本周的三件小事

  1. 读一本与工作无关的书
  2. 用相机记录清晨的光线
  3. 给很久没见的朋友写封信

周末观察：试着用一句话记录今天最喜欢的瞬间。

下周见，山海编辑部

en-US.name: Coastline Journal
en-US.subject: Coastline Journal #42: Make room for curiosity
en-US.text: This week: city walks, independent bookshops and slower living. Take a sunny afternoon to explore a street you have never walked before.
en-US.html:
COASTLINE JOURNAL / ISSUE 42

Make room for curiosity

Cities, nature, and small discoveries in everyday life.

A different way to discover your city

You do not need to go far. Walk by the river, visit the bookshop on the corner, ask your barista about today's beans. Inspiration lives in the details.

Three little things for this week

  1. Read something unrelated to work
  2. Photograph the early morning light
  3. Write to a friend you have not seen in a while

Weekend observation: capture your favorite moment in a single sentence.

See you next week,
The Coastline editors
